VBO:0201044.summary: Pom–Chow mixes can be lively and affectionate once they feel comfortable with someone. Luna, a six-year-old Pomeranian–Chow cross, was initially very scared of people but warmed as she got to know them. A different adult, Foxy, was described as friendly and laid-back, enjoying daily walks, treats and snuggle time.
VBO:0201044.shortDescription: Some Pom–Chow mixes warm from wariness into lively affection; others show an easygoing love of walks and close company.
